name: IMPACT Growth Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Impact Growth Real Estate Investment Trust is a real estate investment trust established under the Trust for Transaction in Capital Market Act, B.E.2550 in accordance with the Trust Deed signed on 22 September 2014 between RMI Company Limited as the Trust Settlor and Kasikorn Asset Management Company Limited as the Trustee. On 22 September 2014, the Trust was established as a specific closed-end real estate investment trust with an indefinite term in order to invest in specific properties.
